newsitem.title: USA: JOHNS MANVILLE SETS FILTRATION CONSOLIDATION.
newsitem.headline: JOHNS MANVILLE SETS FILTRATION CONSOLIDATION.

text.p: Johns Manville Corp said Wednesday it is consolidating its East Stroudsburg, Pa., manufacturing operations at its Richland, Miss., plant.

Both plants manufacture synthetic filtration products, the company said. It acquired the East Stroudsburg facility from Web Dynamics in February 1996 and the Richland facility from Ergon Nonwovens Inc in February of this year.

The anticipated completion of the consolidation is the first quarter of 1998, Johns Manville said. Both facilities will continue to operate during the consolidation and there will be no disruption of service to customers.
"This decision will allow us to create one center of excellence for meltblown technologies and, at the same time, capture some economies of scale," the company said.
The East Stroudsburg facility has been in operation for about three years and employs about 60 people. The company said it plans to transfer some employees from East Stroudsburg to Richland.
